story: Sir Cedric sets out on a quest to find a magical treasure. Along the way, he is joined by his friends Tobias and Elara. Together they face dangerous mountains, magical forests, and powerful enemies. When they finally reach the treasure, they discover that the true reward is their friendship and teamwork, which helped them overcome every challenge.
